translations.3. 카드의 종류와 읽는 법: 3. Types of cards and how to read them
translations.4. 승패 판정과 대응 없음: 4. Win/loss decision and Failure to Respond
translations.5. 페이즈별 진행과 제한시간: 5. Progress and time limit for each phase
translations.7. 대회 제한시간과 시간 종료 처리: 7. Competition time limit and timeout processing
translations.8. 결과 보고·항복·기권·지각: 8. Report results, surrender, abstain, be late
translations.“루멘 페이즈에” 처리한다고 적힌 카드 효과를 우선권 보유자부터 처리합니: Card effects that are written to be processed “on Lumen Phase” are processed starting from the owner of Priority.
translations.각 존에 놓을 수 있는 카드, 공개 여부, 순서와 이동 결과를 확인합니다: Check the cards that can be placed in each zone, whether they are revealed, the order, and the results of the moves.
translations.각 존을 눌러 어떤 카드가 놓이고 어디를 읽어야 하는지 빠르게 확인합니다: Tap on each zone to quickly see which cards are placed and where to read them.
translations.각 플레이어가 사용할 기술 카드 1장을 골라 배틀 존에 뒷면으로 놓습니다: Each player chooses a card Technique Card 1 to use and places it face down on Battle Zone.
translations.게임 중 제한적으로 사용하는 강력한 카드입니다. 공격·수비형과 특수 기술: This is a powerful card with limited use during the game. The usage paths for the attack/defense type and the Special Technique type are different.
translations.게임은 다섯 페이즈를 반복합니다. 각 버튼을 누르면 그 페이즈에서 하는: The game repeats five phases. When you press each button, you can see what it does in that phase.
Report results, surrender, abstain, tardiness, check Time Extension criteria.
translations.공격 기술의 판정 속도에 영향을 주는 수치입니다. 양수는 빨라지고 음수는: This is a value that affects Final Speed of Attack Technique. Positive numbers make it faster and negative numbers make it slower.
translations.공격 기술의 판정 순서에 관여하는 수치입니다. FP 보정과 함께 실제 빠: This is a value involved in the judgment order of Attack Technique. FP Determines the actual speed along with correction.
This is an effect that is processed when Attack Technique is successful or certain conditions are met.
This is the basic damage applied when an attack hits.
translations.기본적으로 비공개이며, 브레이크 보충 등으로 리스트에 카드를 보낼 때 사: It is basically private, and is used when sending cards to the list as Break supplements, etc.
This is the image area that shows the Technique.
translations.대회 중 자주 확인하는 시간, 대응 없음, 결과 보고, 패널티 기준으로: Go directly to times, Failure to Respond, results reports, and penalty criteria, which you frequently check during competitions.
translations.덱 구성, 캐릭터 카드, 특성 카드, 공격·수비 기술의 기본 정의를 확인: Check the basic definitions of deck building, Character Card, Trait Card, attack·Defense Technique.
translations.동시에 처리할 효과, 강제/임의 효과, 텍스트 충돌과 대기 효과를 확인합: Check which effects to process simultaneously, forced/random effects, text collisions and atmospheric effects.
Check for special situations related to ending the game, such as Defense Over and Sudden Death.
translations.레디 페이즈에 선택한 기술 카드를 뒷면으로 두고, 배틀 페이즈에 공개해: The selected Technique Card is placed face down in Ready Phase and revealed to Battle Phase for judgment.
Check the time limit applied in Ready, Get, Lumen, and Recovery Phase.
Check the order of Lumen, Ready, Battle, Get, Recovery Phase.
translations.방어 또는 회피가 어느 위치를 막는지 표시합니다. 상대 공격 위치와 맞으: Indicates which positions are blocked by block or dodge. If it hits the opponent Attack Level, it is used for defense judgment.
Check for illegal movement of Break, discard, supplement, Special Technique.
translations.브레이크된 카드를 두는 영역입니다. 일반적으로 그 게임에서 다시 사용할: This is the area where Break cards are placed. Normally you can't use it again in that game.
This is the name of the character you are using. It becomes the standard for character decks and characteristics.
translations.상대 공격을 막거나 피하는 카드입니다. 방어/회피 위치가 상대 공격 위치: This card blocks or avoids the opponent's attack. Make sure your defense/evasion position matches the opponent's Attack Level.
translations.상대가 레디한 뒤 10초 안에 레디하지 못한 경우의 처리와 누적 기준을: Check the handling and accumulation criteria for cases where the opponent fails to be ready within 10 seconds after being ready.
translations.상대에게 데미지를 주는 기술 카드입니다. 속도, 위치, FP 결과, 데미: It is Technique Card that causes damage to the opponent. View speed, position, FP result, and damage together.
translations.속도, FP, 공격 대 공격, 공격 대 수비, 무승부와 상쇄 판정을 확인: Check speed, FP, attack vs. attack, attack vs. defense, draw, and Clash decisions.
Indicates whether the attack is with the hand or the foot.
The name is Defense Technique Card.
This is the area to process when the defense is successful or to check additional conditions.
Confirm Switzerland and mains base time, final time, and post-time processing.
translations.양쪽의 레디 카드를 공개하고 공격·수비 결과, FP, 데미지, 콤보와 캐: Reveal both sides' ready cards and deal with the attack/defense results, FP, damage, combo, and Catch.
translations.얼티밋 기술 카드가 기본적으로 앞면으로 공개되는 영역입니다. 덱에는 0~: Ultimate Technique Card is the front-facing area by default. You can put 0 to 1 cards in your deck.
The name is Ultimate Technique Card. You can only have 0~1 cards in your deck.
This is a key area to check the terms of use and processing of Ultimate Technique.
This is a large illustration area for the Ultimate Card.
translations.우선권 보유자부터 리스트 카드 1장을 보여주고 패에 넣습니다. 조건에 따: The owner of Priority shows the list card 1 and puts it into his hand. Depending on conditions, you can also get Ultimate.
translations.이 예시에는 상단 회피와 그랩이 있습니다. 회피, 상쇄, 그랩처럼 기술이: This example has a top dodge and Grab. Check the special judgments of Techniques such as Evasion, Clash, Grab.
This indicates that this card is Ultimate Technique.
Call Jersey, check Public Information, and check precautions for using mobile devices.
translations.주의, 경고, 몰수패, 실격, 자격 정지의 의미와 누적 기준을 확인합니다: Check the meaning and cumulative criteria of Caution, Warning, Game Loss, Disqualification, Suspension.
translations.지금 확인하려는 판정이 어느 장에 있는지 먼저 고르고, 해당 규칙 장으로: First select which chapter the decision you want to check is in, and then move to the corresponding rules chapter.
translations.처음에는 모든 항목을 외우기보다 카드 종류와 쓰이는 위치를 먼저 구분하면: At first, rather than memorizing all the items, you can first distinguish between the types of cards and where they are used.
translations.체력 구간마다 손패 상한이 어떻게 변하는지 표시합니다. 예를 들어 400: Displays how the hand loss limit changes for each HP range. For example, if it becomes 4000 or less, the hand limit will be expanded to 7.
This card checks your HP and hand limit. This becomes the player's baseline information.
translations.최대 14장의 공개 기술 카드가 놓이는 기본 덱 영역입니다. 패에서 버린: This is the basic deck area where up to 14 Technique Card are placed. Cards discarded from your hand are moved to the list.
This is the creator of the card illustration.
translations.카드 그림 제작자 표기입니다. 게임 처리에는 사용하지 않는 제작 정보입니: This is the creator of the card illustration. This is production information that is not used for game processing.
translations.카드 하단의 짧은 대사나 분위기 문구입니다. 일반적으로 룰 처리는 효과: This is a short line or mood phrase at the bottom of the card. Typically, rule processing is checked based on the effect text.
translations.카드 효과로 루멘 존에 배치된 카드를 둡니다. 카드별 지시에 따라 사용합: Place the card placed on Lumen Zone as a card effect. Use according to the instructions on each card.
translations.카드가 실제로 처리하는 문장입니다. 발동 시점, 조건, 처리 순서가 적혀: These are the sentences that the card actually deals with. The trigger timing, conditions, and processing order are written down, so read them most closely when making a decision.
translations.카드를 식별하는 가장 기본 정보입니다. 같은 이름의 다른 판본도 같은 카: This is the most basic information that identifies the card. Different editions of the same name are often treated as the same card.
translations.카드명 아래에 배치된 짧은 문구입니다. 게임 처리는 효과 텍스트를 기준으: This is a short phrase placed below the card name. Game processing is checked against effect text.
translations.카드의 시각적 중심 영역입니다. 룰 처리에는 보통 직접 쓰이지 않지만 카: This is the visual central area of the card. It is not usually used directly in rule processing, but is helpful in card identification.
Check the edition and listing number of the card.
translations.카드의 판본을 식별하는 정보입니다. 같은 카드의 다른 수록이나 레어도를: Information that identifies the edition of the card. Used to distinguish between different inclusions or rarities of the same card.
translations.캐릭터 고유의 기능과 조건이 적힌 영역입니다. 게임 시작 직후부터 적용되: This is an area where the character's unique functions and conditions are written. There are many effects that take effect right after the game starts.
translations.캐릭터 고유의 기능과 효과를 가진 카드입니다. 게임 시작 직후부터 적용됩: This card has functions and effects unique to the character. It takes effect immediately after starting the game.
translations.캐릭터 고유의 특성 카드가 놓이고, 게임 시작 직후부터 기능과 효과가 적: The character's unique Trait Card is placed, and functions and effects are applied immediately after starting the game.
Check the edition and listing number of Character Card.
This is the largest image area that identifies the character.
Check for Catch condition, Catch processing, continuation Catch and special situations.
Check combo entry, damage compensation, combo common processing, and special processing.
translations.턴 종료 시 효과를 처리한 뒤 지속 효과를 종료하고 다음 턴으로 넘어갑니: At the end of the turn, the effect is processed and the continuous effect ends and moves on to the next turn.
Check the procedures for using Special Technique and the results of moving Ultimate Technique.
translations.플레이어가 들고 있는 비공개 카드입니다. 체력 구간에 따라 손패 상한이: This is a private card held by the player. The upper hand loss limit varies depending on the HP level.
translations.플레이어를 나타내는 캐릭터 카드가 놓입니다. 현재 체력과 손패 상한의 기: Character Card is placed to represent the player. This is the basis for your current HP and hand loss limit.
The FP gained or lost is displayed based on the results of hits, guards, and counters.
